what_works: Ample white space and consistent 1px/2px spacing create a clean, uncluttered layout.
Rounded 8px corners on buttons and cards give a modern, approachable feel while maintaining a flat aesthetic.
Strategic use of a primary accent color (rgb 255,212,255) highlights interactive elements against a neutral background for clear hierarchy.
Large headline typography with varied font sizes establishes visual hierarchy, guiding the user's eye to key actions.
Interactive components are clearly marked with subtle outlines and hover states, supporting easy navigation.
